annotations.title: Copy an Instant Form with the consent checkbox

description:
[writes · `ads:manage` scope] Copies a live Meta Instant Form (copyFromFormId) into a new form with the same questions, pages and privacy link, plus the brand's saved consent checkbox (save it first with ads_lead_form_consent_set). Optional name. Meta forms cannot be edited, so this is how an ad gets consent; then point the ad at the new formId with ads_lead_form_swap_ad. One vendor call, never retried. Pass agentName and reason. Audited in Ads > Agent activity.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/lead-forms/consent-copy.)

agentName.description: Which agent is acting. Shown to the owner in Ads > Agent activity.

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

reason.description: Why the agent is doing this. Shown to the owner and kept in the audit trail.

name: ads_lead_form_consent_copy
title: Copy an Instant Form with the consent checkbox
